name: xdbml
__comment_top__: DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE DIRECTLY. Edit xdbml.tmLanguage.template.json and run tools/textmate/scripts/build.mjs. Placeholder strings (delimited by double underscores) are filled with case-insensitive regex alternations from parser/src/keywords.ts.

patterns.comment: Top-of-file version directive: `xdbml: 0.1` or `experimental: ...`. Recognized only at the start of a line with the colon immediately after, to avoid colliding with `xdbml` appearing elsewhere.

module-directives.comment: v0.2 module system (spec §26): `use` / `reuse ... from '...'` directives, plus the `as` alias keyword. Matched as standalone words anywhere; TextMate cannot disambiguate context cheaply, but these keywords are rare outside their proper position so false positives are minimal. The `as` keyword also serves DBML table-aliasing (`Table users as u`) for which the same scope is appropriate.

declarations.comment: All declaration keywords. The keyword is followed by an identifier (the declared name).

type-keywords.comment: Structural type and polymorphism keywords (object, array, oneOf, etc.). Matched wherever they appear -- which in xDBML is always in a type position after a colon, but TextMate doesn't track context cheaply, so we accept them anywhere.

x-properties.comment: Custom AI-readiness properties prefixed with `x_` or `x-`. Highlighted as extension points.
x-properties.name: support.other.x-property.xdbml

settings-block.comment: Square-bracket settings block. Inside, we recognize flag settings, keyed settings, ordinary string/number values, and cardinality operators (>, <, -) for Ref-style settings.

setting-keys.comment: Setting keys appear before a colon. Matched only here inside the settings block.

cardinality-strings.comment: Cardinality settings have values like '0..*' or '1..1' that we color as a distinct kind of string.
cardinality-strings.name: string.unquoted.cardinality.xdbml

ref-cardinality-operators.comment: Cardinality operators (>, <, -, <>) in Ref declarations. Recognized between two qualified identifiers (foo.bar > baz.qux). The pattern requires word characters or dots on each side to avoid matching `>` in comments or other contexts.
ref-cardinality-operators.name: keyword.operator.cardinality.xdbml

patterns.comment: Triple-quoted multi-line string (DBML extension). Must come before single-quoted matcher.
patterns.name: string.quoted.triple.xdbml

patterns.comment: Double-quoted identifier (used to escape reserved keywords as names).
patterns.name: string.quoted.double.xdbml
